title: Exact Asymptotic Rates and an Exponential Strong Converse for quantum SMP and One-Way Communication
summary: Computing many instances jointly can reduce communication per instance. We ask whether such savings occur in the simultaneous-message-passing (SMP) model and how they depend on quantum messages and shared resources. For every finite total function $f$ and fixed error $0\le\varepsilon<1$, we prove that the optimal worst-case communication per instance for $f^n$ converges to \[ D^\parallel(f)=\log|\mathrm{Row}(f)|+\log|\mathrm{Col}(f)|, \] where $\mathrm{Row}(f)$ and $\mathrm{Col}(f)$ are the sets of distinct rows and columns of the table $(f(x,y))_{x,y}$.
